## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle Eastern Hàn 後漢 translation of a discourse using the metaphor of eight kinds of horse to illustrate eight kinds of disciple. Sub-titled "出雜阿含別譯". The Chinese parallels are T99[924] and T100[149].

**Abstract**

T115 was produced during Zhī Yào's Hàn period (185–220 CE), recorded in the frontmatter. The Indic source is presumed lost.
